claims.head: Heavyweight bout
claims.body: The Mammoth are one of the league’s best for shot volume, but the Lightning are one of the best at keeping shots away. Hot take: the Mammoth break through anyway.

claims.head: Tired legs for the Lightning
claims.body: The Lightning played last night and get no rest before this one. Teams in that spot usually get the worse of the chances, so we expect the Mammoth to control more of the play than they usually do.
claims.call: The Mammoth get a bigger share of the 5-on-5 chances than they usually do.

notes.text: They dressed 11 forwards and 7 defensemen in 9 of their last 10 games, including the last one. Gage Goncalves takes shifts on two lines, L1 and L3. Victor Hedman is the seventh defenseman, rotating in mostly beside Crozier and Černák.
Yanni Gourde is on the injured non-roster list (hip surgery) and has not played this season. Ilya Mikheyev has taken his spot beside Zemgus Girgensons and Pontus Holmberg.
Max Crozier returned in their last game after missing 2 games.
John Carlson is no longer killing penalties: 0% of the team’s shorthanded time in 10 games, down from 47% with his old team last season.
Emil Lilleberg is no longer killing penalties: 4% of the team’s shorthanded time in 4 games, down from 32% last season.

faceoff.text: Anthony Cirelli is sent out to take power-play faceoffs, then changes. He has taken 51% of the team’s power-play draws but stays on for about 25 seconds at a time, against 66 for the regulars, and is most often replaced by Brandon Hagel (17 of 24 changes).

notes.text: John Marino is day to day (upper-body injury) and has missed the last 2 games. He is a top-pair defenseman. Andrew Peeke has taken his spot beside Nate Schmidt.

UTA.head: Advantage, the Mammoth
UTA.body: The two have been about even at out-chancing opponents lately. Even though Utah may be without Marino, Tampa Bay is on the second night of a back-to-back, and the Mammoth have home-ice advantage. The Lightning can make it interesting if they get good looks.

TBL.head: The Lightning have a hill to climb
TBL.body: The two have been about even at out-chancing opponents lately. Even though Utah may be without Marino, Tampa Bay is on the second night of a back-to-back, and the Mammoth have home-ice advantage. The Lightning can pull it off if they get good looks.
